import pytest
from rich.console import Console
from rich.screen import Screen

def test_double_width_character_in_modal():
    console = Console(color_system=None, width=93, height=34, legacy_windows=False)
    with console.capture() as capture:
        console.print(Screen("あ\nあ"))  # Using a double-width character
    result = capture.get()
    expected = "あ                                       \nあ                                       "
    assert result == expected
